rows.note: the 2.x oxlint preset and its `basalt` JS plugin (`configs/oxlint-plugin.js`) are deleted in 3.0, with the `basalt/*` 2.x rule ids and the `theme-allow` annotation; instead: `basalt-ui init` (or `sync`) writes `.oxlintrc.basalt.json` for your profile and `basalt-ui lint` runs it; a waiver is `// oxlint-disable-next-line basalt/<id> -- <why>`, and the 2.x ids map to the 15 v3 rule ids

the 2.x guards-only preset is deleted in 3.0 with the plugin it loaded; instead: the `bridge` profile, the lightest of the three generated presets (`configs/oxlint-{bridge,parts,app}.json`), for a repo with history to take first
